NO reescribir en otro stack. Iterar con PySide6 + Nuitka + python-mpv
decisions.reason: Tauon Music Player demuestra Python viable. Problemas son pygame y PyInstaller, no Python. Reescritura = 6-12 meses sin features.

decisions.decision: Plan de refactoring v2 aprobado: 4 fases, 6 semanas
decisions.reason: Auditoria revelo 9 criticos, 8 altos. Score 6.8/10 necesita mejora antes de nuevas features.

decisions.decision: Phase 1.1-1.4 completadas: auth token, path validation, plugin whitelist, URL validation, threading locks
decisions.reason: 99/99 tests pasando. Criticos C1, C2, C3, A1 resueltos. Quedan C4 (metodos truncados), C5 (audio_player locks), C6 (except Exception).

decisions.decision: Phase 1 complete. C4 was false positive (methods complete, auditor had line limits). C5 resolved with RLock. C6 priority files fixed, GUI catches deferred.
decisions.reason: 111/111 tests passing (35+28+18+18+12). All 3 critical security vulns fixed. Starting Phase 2.

decisions.decision: Phase 2.1 complete: Split main.py God Class (1373 LOC) into Facade (303 LOC) + 4 controllers
decisions.reason: Created playback_controller (312), ui_composer (567), remote_controller (147), library_controller (120). 38 new tests + 111 existing = 149 all passing. stats_controller.py skipped — no meaningful logic in main.py for it.

decisions.decision: Phase 2.2 complete: BaseTab class + 5 tabs refactored. 8 remaining tabs deferred.
decisions.reason: BaseTab (230 LOC) with progress infra + connect_worker + dialogs. 5 tabs fully refactored (duplicates, rename, organize, cleanup, import) — 261 LOC eliminated. 8 remaining tabs have non-standard signal patterns (content_filter, cloud_sync) or no worker boilerplate (library, lyrics, plugins, remote, search, statistics) — low ROI for BaseTab migration. 38 new BaseTab tests + 106 total passing.

decisions.decision: Phase 2.3 complete: Split audio_embeddings.py (1074 LOC) into 4 files with clear SRP.
decisions.reason: AudioEmbeddings Facade (501 LOC) delegates to AudioFeatureExtractor (291 LOC), BPMDetector (155 LOC), MoodClassifier (215 LOC). Public API unchanged — backward compat delegation for private methods used by tests. 37/37 existing tests pass, 0 consumer changes needed (recommendations_widget.py, library_tab.py).

decisions.decision: Phase 2 COMPLETE. Phase 2.4+2.6 merged (dead code deletion). Phase 2.5 (DI) deferred.
decisions.reason: cleanup_assistant_tab.py (1210 LOC) + main_window_complete.py (804 LOC) were dead code — only referenced each other. Deleted both (2014 LOC removed). DI/ServiceFactory deferred: main.py is already 303 LOC, adding AppContext + factory adds files without clear benefit at this scale. Total Phase 2 impact: main.py 1373→303, audio_embeddings 1074→501, 2014 LOC dead code deleted, 5 tabs refactored with BaseTab.
